# Cloudflare
> Cloudflare provides connectivity cloud services including CDN, security, Zero Trust, developer platform, DNS, networking, and AI infrastructure.

Cloudflare’s documentation spans application security, performance, networking, developer tools, data services, and platform APIs. The resources below prioritize product documentation, API references, guides, and operational references useful for LLMs.

## Documentation Home
- [Documentation Home](https://developers.cloudflare.com/): Entry point for Cloudflare product documentation, tutorials, and references.
- [API Documentation](https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/): Overview of Cloudflare APIs, authentication, and product endpoints.
- [Learning Paths](https://developers.cloudflare.com/learning-paths/): Guided learning journeys across major Cloudflare products and workflows.
- [Reference Architecture Center](https://developers.cloudflare.com/reference-architecture/): Architectural patterns and deployment guidance for Cloudflare services.
- [Cloudflare Fundamentals](https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/): Core concepts, account structure, plans, and platform basics.
- [Support](https://developers.cloudflare.com/support/): Troubleshooting, contact options, and support process documentation.

## DNS, Traffic, and Performance
- [DNS](https://developers.cloudflare.com/dns/): Manage authoritative DNS, records, zones, and advanced DNS features.
- [CDN](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cache/): Caching, cache rules, purge behavior, and content delivery optimization.
- [Load Balancing](https://developers.cloudflare.com/load-balancing/): Distribute traffic across origins with health checks and steering policies.
- [Health Checks](https://developers.cloudflare.com/health-checks/): Monitor endpoint availability for failover and traffic management.
- [Rules](https://developers.cloudflare.com/rules/): Configure request handling with rules products and matching expressions.
- [Speed](https://developers.cloudflare.com/speed/): Improve web performance with optimization features and delivery controls.
- [Images](https://developers.cloudflare.com/images/): Store, transform, optimize, and deliver images at scale.

## Security and Application Protection
- [WAF](https://developers.cloudflare.com/waf/): Protect applications with managed rules, custom rules, and security controls.
- [DDoS Protection](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ddos-protection/): Mitigate network and application layer denial-of-service attacks.
- [Bot Management](https://developers.cloudflare.com/bots/): Detect, score, and mitigate automated traffic and abusive bots.
- [Turnstile](https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/): Privacy-preserving CAPTCHA alternative for bot and abuse prevention.
- [Rate Limiting Rules](https://developers.cloudflare.com/waf/rate-limiting-rules/): Throttle abusive traffic using request matching and thresholds.
- [SSL/TLS](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ssl/): Encrypt traffic, manage certificates, and configure TLS behavior.
- [Page Shield](https://developers.cloudflare.com/page-shield/): Monitor browser-side scripts for supply chain and client-side risks.

## Zero Trust and Access
- [Cloudflare One](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/): Zero Trust platform for secure access, networking, and data protection.
- [Access](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/applications/configure-apps/): Protect self-hosted and SaaS applications with identity-aware access controls.
- [Gateway](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/policies/gateway/): Secure web, DNS, and network traffic with filtering and policy enforcement.
- [WARP Client](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/connections/connect-devices/warp/): Device client for secure connectivity and Zero Trust enrollment.
- [Tunnel](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/connections/connect-networks/): Publish private services securely without exposing inbound ports.
- [Browser Isolation](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/policies/browser-isolation/): Isolate web sessions remotely to reduce client-side risk.
- [CASB](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/insights/casb/): Discover and remediate SaaS misconfigurations and risky user behavior.

## Developer Platform
- [Workers](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/): Serverless JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, and Rust applications at the edge.
- [Workers Runtime API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/runtime-apis/): Runtime interfaces, bindings, and execution environment references.
- [Pages](https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/): Deploy full-stack applications and static sites on Cloudflare’s platform.
- [Queues](https://developers.cloudflare.com/queues/): Message queues for asynchronous processing and event-driven architectures.
- [Workflows](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workflows/): Durable orchestration for multi-step application logic and automation.
- [Cron Triggers](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/configuration/cron-triggers/): Schedule Workers to run on recurring time-based intervals.
- [Hyperdrive](https://developers.cloudflare.com/hyperdrive/): Accelerate database access from Workers with connection pooling and caching.

## Data, Storage, and Databases
- [R2](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/): S3-compatible object storage without egress fees for many workloads.
- [D1](https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/): Serverless SQLite database integrated with Workers and edge applications.
- [KV](https://developers.cloudflare.com/kv/): Globally distributed key-value storage for configuration and cached data.
- [Durable Objects](https://developers.cloudflare.com/durable-objects/): Stateful coordination primitives for strongly consistent application logic.
- [Vectorize](https://developers.cloudflare.com/vectorize/): Vector database for embeddings and similarity search on Cloudflare.
- [Analytics Engine](https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/analytics-engine/): Write and query high-cardinality analytics data from Workers.
- [Stream](https://developers.cloudflare.com/stream/): Video ingestion, storage, encoding, and delivery APIs.

## AI and Machine Learning
- [Workers AI](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/): Run inference on GPUs globally using Cloudflare’s AI platform.
- [AI Gateway](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/): Observe, secure, and control traffic to AI model providers.
- [Vectorize](https://developers.cloudflare.com/vectorize/): Store and query embeddings for semantic search and retrieval workflows.
- [Browser Rendering](https://developers.cloudflare.com/browser-rendering/): Automate browsers and extract content from web pages programmatically.
- [AutoRAG](https://developers.cloudflare.com/autorag/): Build retrieval-augmented generation pipelines on Cloudflare infrastructure.
- [Model Context Protocol Servers](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/model-context-protocol/): Build MCP-compatible services and agent integrations on Cloudflare.
- [Agents](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/): Develop agentic applications using Cloudflare’s AI and developer primitives.

## Networking and Connectivity
- [Magic WAN](https://developers.cloudflare.com/magic-wan/): Connect branch, cloud, and data center networks through Cloudflare.
- [Magic Transit](https://developers.cloudflare.com/magic-transit/): Protect and accelerate IP networks with DDoS mitigation and routing.
- [Magic Firewall](https://developers.cloudflare.com/magic-firewall/): Enforce L3/L4 network firewall policies across connected environments.
- [Network Interconnect](https://developers.cloudflare.com/network-interconnect/): Establish private connectivity into Cloudflare’s global network.
- [IP Addresses and Domains](https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/concepts/cloudflare-ip-addresses/): Reference Cloudflare IP ranges and network identity concepts.
- [Cloudflare Tunnel](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/connections/connect-networks/): Securely connect private networks and services to Cloudflare.
- [Spectrum](https://developers.cloudflare.com/spectrum/): Proxy and protect TCP, UDP, and gaming or non-HTTP applications.

## API, Tooling, and SDKs
- [API Reference](https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/): Endpoint-by-endpoint reference for Cloudflare platform APIs.
- [API Tokens](https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/): Create scoped API tokens for secure programmatic access.
- [Terraform Provider](https://developers.cloudflare.com/terraform/): Manage Cloudflare resources declaratively with Terraform.
- [Wrangler](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/wrangler/): CLI for building, testing, and deploying Workers applications.
- [Workers SDK](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/frameworks/): Framework integration guidance for building on Workers and Pages.
- [OpenAPI Schemas](https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/): Machine-readable API definitions for Cloudflare endpoints.
- [GraphQL API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/graphql-api/): Query analytics and network data using Cloudflare’s GraphQL interface.

## Observability, Analytics, and Logs
- [Analytics](https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/): Product analytics capabilities, datasets, and usage patterns.
- [GraphQL Analytics API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/graphql-api/): Query detailed analytics across zones, accounts, and products.
- [Logpush](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/): Export Cloudflare logs to storage and SIEM destinations.
- [Logs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/): Logging products, datasets, and operational guidance.
- [Web Analytics](https://developers.cloudflare.com/web-analytics/): Privacy-focused website analytics without client-side profiling.
- [Cloudflare Radar](https://radar.cloudflare.com/): Internet traffic, outages, attacks, and protocol trend insights.
- [Status](https://www.cloudflarestatus.com/): Real-time service availability and incident reporting for Cloudflare systems.

## Release Notes and Changelog
- [Documentation Changelog](https://developers.cloudflare.com/changelog/): Product and documentation release notes across Cloudflare services.
- [Workers Changelog](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/changelog/): Runtime, platform, and feature updates for Workers.
- [Pages Changelog](https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/platform/changelog/): Release notes for Pages platform capabilities and changes.
- [D1 Release Notes](https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/platform/release-notes/): Updates and changes for the D1 serverless database.
- [R2 Release Notes](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/platform/release-notes/): Product updates and behavior changes for R2 storage.
- [Cloudflare One Release Notes](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/release-notes/): Zero Trust and connectivity platform release updates.
